_readme: THE SHOP'S PRICE LIST. Set each piece's "price" to its price in Australian dollars (for example 85 or 149.50). While price is null the piece shows 'Price to come' (jewellery) or 'Price on enquiry' (art) and visitors can enquire but not buy. When an original painting sells, set "sold": true on it here and in data.js. You can also change a piece's name or desc here. Save, commit and push, and the shop and checkout update. Do not change the ids.
